name: long-horizon-prototype
title_zh: 隔天开机还记得上次干到哪的长期任务代理
tagline_zh: 每次新开对话都要从头交代背景、把上周的结论再讲一遍？它把每轮的动作、证据和踩过的坑落盘。
tagline_en: Tired of re-explaining context every session? It persists actions, evidence, and learnings to disk, then picks.
desc_en: Continue an authorized responsibility across separate sessions using its saved actions, evidence, and learnings to choose useful next work.
why_zh: 决策依据是历史证据而不是当前这轮对话，所以跨会话不会漂移；每步都留下可复查的痕迹，而不是靠记忆续写。
why_en: It decides from persisted evidence, not the current chat window, so multi-session work doesn't drift — and every step leaves an.
limit_zh: 只对已获授权的责任生效，没明确授权它不会自己开工；证据与动作存在本地文件里，换机器或清目录就断档。
limit_en: Only runs on responsibilities you've explicitly authorized; state lives in local files, so switching machines or wiping the dir breaks continuity.
title_en: A long-horizon agent that resumes where the last session.
